description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A long tea tray has a removable plain slatted bamboo top above a ceramic drainage basin. Side: The shallow outer woven basket wraps the basin without contacting water. Rear: A solid rear rail and the basin's removable access recess remain visible. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
